_help: Herald's numbers on herald.html (Herald's log). Written after his runs. live=false keeps the page's placeholders. runs = counted autopilot runs; quests_completed = quests rewarded across all runs; bugs_found = issues Herald reported that the team confirmed; best_times = seconds, keyed by route (northshire_1_5 = Human Hunter, Northshire, levels 1 to 5); last_run = ISO 8601 time; status = running | testing | idle | paused.
